amplitude_normalization: 2 * abs(rfft(x * w)) / sum(w); DC/Nyquist not doubled

window_boundary_policy: Match application: replace indices 1..32766 (zero-based); retain nominal reconstruction at rows 0 and 32767.

noise_floor_definition: 10log10 of expected squared single-sided coherent-gain-corrected FFT amplitude; not mean log amplitude.
interpretation: Reference ceiling only. Does not establish absence of overfitting or preservation of every noise realization.
